files.content: fn record(&mut self, at: u64, kind: Kind) { if let Err(e) = self.recording.append(at, kind) { self.capture_stopped = true; } }
fn record(&mut self, at: u64, kind: Kind) { let removed = self.recording.append_retained(at, kind)?; self.presentation.discard_prefix(removed); }
fn read(&mut self, at: u64, kind: Kind) { self.recording.append(at, kind)?; }
